answer: Joint-liability bond pools resist sybils: identities traced to one funding inlet post bonds into a shared pool under joint-and-several liability, so if any single member is caught cheating the entire cluster's stake is forfeit. A sable-dark farm of a hundred fakes behind one purse now risks all hundred bonds on the exposure of any one; capital at risk scales with cluster size, not per head. A lone honest agent shares a pool with no one, its walnut-small bond exposed only to its own conduct. Mass identity creation concentrates correlated slashing risk, pricing scale in forfeited capital.
